datasets.title: Study Area
datasets.description: ClearCast City of St. Petersburg coastal guidance. Observed window: previous 24 hours; forecast model horizon: 120 hours. STOFS2D daily baseline; valid local P-Surge enables e50 most-likely and e10 high-end coastal guidance with WPC P90 rainfall. Source cycle/advisory is recorded in latest-run metadata. Coastal inundation is derived by interpolating selected coastal forecast reference levels over terrain; rainfall is a separate guidance overlay, not a coupled rainfall/runoff simulation. Latest operational records replace previous records; event archives are maintained in Clearview Azure.

curatedUpdates.terms: The official County item offers data as-is for reference, says it is not of survey precision, and does not name an unrestricted reuse license. Source: https://pinellas-egis.maps.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/content/items/c4679b6609234442bbefc3b667725809?f=pjson
curatedUpdates.scopeNote: Countywide plan categories support regional analysis but are not parcel zoning or a legal survey. The hosted view may change as Forward Pinellas updates its plan.

curatedUpdates.title: Pinellas bicycle facilities
curatedUpdates.description: Bicycle facility segments with type, width, jurisdiction, roadway, and high-injury-network attributes.
curatedUpdates.terms: The official County item offers data as-is for reference, says it is not of survey precision, and does not name an unrestricted reuse license. Source: https://pinellas-egis.maps.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/content/items/271578471c694165b90b58c868e8a4bb?f=pjson
curatedUpdates.scopeNote: Facility classes vary and mapped segments do not establish current safety or continuity. This inventory complements, rather than duplicates, the Pinellas Trail layer.

curatedUpdates.title: Pinellas sidewalks
curatedUpdates.description: Countywide sidewalk segments with surface, width, condition, accessibility, and municipality attributes.
curatedUpdates.terms: The official County item offers data as-is for reference, says it is not of survey precision, and does not name an unrestricted reuse license. Source: https://pinellas-egis.maps.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/content/items/1b7e0d3791d94ffc8e8cadd15b392a37?f=pjson
curatedUpdates.scopeNote: Mapped inventory and source attributes are for planning; accessibility and condition classifications do not guarantee current on-the-ground conditions.

curatedUpdates.title: Pinellas assisted housing
curatedUpdates.description: Assisted-housing development polygons with program, unit-count, target-population, and subsidy attributes.
curatedUpdates.terms: The official County item offers data as-is for reference, says it is not of survey precision, and does not name an unrestricted reuse license. Source: https://pinellas-egis.maps.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/content/items/2277d597855b4fba9e4c3e892bc5ddd7?f=pjson
curatedUpdates.scopeNote: Program participation, assisted-unit counts, and subsidy expiration may change. This layer does not establish current eligibility, availability, or a complete affordable-housing inventory.

curatedUpdates.title: Hillsborough FEMA flood hazard zones
curatedUpdates.description: County-hosted FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer polygons with zone and base-flood-elevation attributes.
curatedUpdates.terms: The official Hillsborough County item disclaims accuracy, completeness, and suitability; no explicit unrestricted reuse license is identified. Source: https://hillsborough.maps.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/content/items/eab9b28e7af94f0dbd8eaaacf7c55f0a?f=pjson
curatedUpdates.scopeNote: The item identifies a latest Letter of Map Revision effective September 28, 2026. A GIS copy is for planning only; use FEMA and County official records for property or legal determinations and current emergency guidance.

curatedUpdates.title: Hillsborough HART bus routes
curatedUpdates.description: Hillsborough-hosted HART route linework with route, direction, and vehicle-type attributes.
curatedUpdates.terms: The official Hillsborough County item disclaims accuracy, completeness, and suitability; no explicit unrestricted reuse license is identified. Source: https://hillsborough.maps.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/content/items/6de4b3ac6ebd4d139edbb5758c2790ec?f=pjson
curatedUpdates.scopeNote: The item identifies a March 2025 HART source even though the hosted layer was edited later. Use for route-planning research, not live schedules, stops, or navigation.

curatedUpdates.title: Hillsborough unincorporated zoning
curatedUpdates.description: Adopted zoning polygons for unincorporated Hillsborough County with district and status attributes.
curatedUpdates.terms: The official County item states Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International. Check the item for required attribution and current zoning caveats. Source: https://hillsborough.maps.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/content/items/1b99b0e8d38d4a85916fb9018b8f74c1?f=pjson
curatedUpdates.scopeNote: Unincorporated county coverage only; municipal zoning is separate. GIS may lag approved zoning-atlas changes, and cross-government zoning labels have different meanings.

curatedUpdates.title: Hillsborough EPC water-quality observations
curatedUpdates.description: Latest staff-reviewed monitoring samples with station, time, nutrients, bacteria, salinity, and oxygen attributes.
curatedUpdates.terms: The County and Environmental Protection Commission item disclaims accuracy, completeness, and suitability; no explicit unrestricted reuse license is identified. Source: https://hillsborough.maps.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/content/items/04f8f5d7491b4d7aa2aacc6df7ea7f13?f=pjson
curatedUpdates.scopeNote: The Environmental Protection Commission's item describes the latest staff-reviewed samples at monitoring stations, not the complete sample history. Methods, units, detection limits, and site coverage require source review.

curatedUpdates.title: Hillsborough 2023 land use and land cover
curatedUpdates.description: County-hosted SWFWMD 2023 land-cover polygons with Florida land-use-code descriptions.
curatedUpdates.terms: The official Hillsborough County item disclaims accuracy, completeness, and suitability; no explicit unrestricted reuse license is identified. Source: https://hillsborough.maps.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/content/items/b2c5c247ca6f482cbf92ea989d90d585?f=pjson
curatedUpdates.scopeNote: A 2023 SWFWMD classification snapshot downloaded by the County in 2025. It is observed land cover, not adopted future land use, zoning, or a current-condition guarantee.

curatedUpdates.title: TBRPC six-county regional boundary
curatedUpdates.description: Dissolved boundary of the Tampa Bay Regional Planning Council's six-county service area.
curatedUpdates.terms: The service-linked TBRPC item states 'no limitations on use'; no standardized license is named on that item. Source: https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/content/items/ab27e5f7ccd743709ce886988691c6b8?f=pjson
curatedUpdates.scopeNote: Derived from 2022 Census boundaries and suitable as a regional analysis frame. It is not a legal boundary survey or current parcel boundary.
